sections.label: Book 25
sections.name: The Horse Sacrifice concluded; eulogy of the Horse

verses.sa: शादं दद्भिरवकां दन्तमूलैर्मृदं बर्स्वैस्तेगान्दंष्ट्राभ्यां सरस्वत्या अग्रजिह्वं जिह्वाया उत्सादमवक्रन्देन तालु वाजं हनुभ्यामप आस्येन वृषणमाण्डाभ्यामादित्याँ श्मश्रुभिः पन्थानं भ्रूभ्यां द्यावापृथिवी वर्तोभ्यां विद्युतं कनीनकाभ्यां शुक्लाय स्वाहा कृष्णाय स्वाहा पार्याणि पक्ष्माण्यवार्या इक्षवोऽवार्याणि पक्ष्माणि पार्या इक्षवः॥
verses.tr: śādaṃ dadbhiravakāṃ dantamūlairmṛdaṃ barsvaistegāndaṃṣṭrābhyāṃ sarasvatyā agrajihvaṃ jihvāyā utsādamavakrandena tālu vājaṃ hanubhyāmapa āsyena vṛṣaṇamāṇḍābhyāmādityāṃ śmaśrubhiḥ panthānaṃ bhrūbhyāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī vartobhyāṃ vidyutaṃ kanīnakābhyāṃ śuklāya svāhā kṛṣṇāya svāhā pāryāṇi pakṣmāṇyavāryā ikṣavo'vāryāṇi pakṣmāṇi pāryā ikṣavaḥ
verses.en: I GRATIFY Fresh Grass with his teeth, Avaki with his gums, Clay with his tooth sockets, Tegas with his fangs. The tongue-lip for Sarasvati; I gratify the root of the tongue and the palate with his neigh, Vaja with his jaws, the Waters with his mouth, the Stallion with his testicles, the Adityas with the beard, Path with his eyebrows, Heaven and Earth with his eyelashes, Lightning with the pupils of his eyes. Hail to the white! Hail to the black! Effectual are his eyelashes, irresistible are his lower eyelashes; irresistible are his eyelashes, effectual are his lower eyelashes.

verses.sa: वातं प्राणेनापानेन नासिके उपयाममधरेणौष्ठेन सदुत्तरेण प्रकाशेनान्तरमनूकाशेन बाह्यं निवेष्यं मूर्ध्ना स्तनयित्नुं निर्बाधेनाशनिं मस्तिष्केण विद्युतं कनीनकाभ्यां कर्णाभ्यां श्रोत्रँ श्रोत्राभ्यां कर्णौ तेदनीमधरकण्ठेनापः शुष्ककण्ठेन चित्तं मन्याभिरदितिं शीर्ष्णा निरृतिं निर्जर्जल्येन शीर्ष्णा संक्रोशैः प्राणान् रेष्माणं स्तुपेन॥
verses.tr: vātaṃ prāṇenāpānena nāsike upayāmamadhareṇauṣṭhena saduttareṇa prakāśenāntaramanūkāśena bāhyaṃ niveṣyaṃ mūrdhnā stanayitnuṃ nirbādhenāśaniṃ mastiṣkeṇa vidyutaṃ kanīnakābhyāṃ karṇābhyāṃ śrotraṃ śrotrābhyāṃ karṇau tedanīmadharakaṇṭhenāpaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhena cittaṃ manyābhiraditiṃ śīrṣṇā nirṛtiṃ nirjarjalyena śīrṣṇā saṃkrośaiḥ prāṇān reṣmāṇaṃ stupena
verses.en: With his breath I gratify Vata; with his outbreath the two Nostrils; with his lower lip the Upayftma; with his upper lip Existence. With his bright look I please Antara, with his reflection B-hya; the Whirlpool with his head; Thunder with his frontal bone; the Lightning-flash with his brain; Lightning with the pupils of his eyes; Hear ing with his external ears; Ears with his internal ears; Blood with his lower neck; Waters with the fleshless part of his neck; Thought with the back neck-tendons; Aditi with his head; Nirriti with his ragged head; Vital Breathings with his roars; Tempest with his crest.

verses.sa: मशकान् केशैरिन्द्रं स्वपसा वहेन बृहस्पतिं शकुनिसादेन कूर्माञ्छफैराक्रमणं स्थूराभ्यामृक्षलाभिः कपिञ्जलाञ्जवं जङ्घाभ्यामध्वानं बाहुभ्यां जाम्बीलेनारण्यमग्निमतिरुग्भ्यां पूषणं दोर्भ्यामश्विनावंसाभ्यां रुद्रं रोराभ्याम्॥
verses.tr: maśakān keśairindraṃ svapasā vahena bṛhaspatiṃ śakunisādena kūrmāñchaphairākramaṇaṃ sthūrābhyāmṛkṣalābhiḥ kapiñjalāñjavaṃ jaṅghābhyāmadhvānaṃ bāhubhyāṃ jāmbīlenāraṇyamagnimatirugbhyāṃ pūṣaṇaṃ dorbhyāmaśvināvaṃsābhyāṃ rudraṃ rorābhyām
verses.en: I gratify Flies with his hair; Indra with his active shoulder; Brihaspati with his quick spring; Tortoises with his hoofs; Approach with his fetlocks; jalas with his heel-ropes; Speed with his two thighs; the Way with his two fore-legs; the Forest-God with a kneepan; Agni with his two knees; Pushan with his two fore-feet; the Asvins with his shoulders; Rudra with his shoulder-joints.

verses.sa: अग्नेः पक्षतिर्वायोर्निपक्षतिरिन्द्रस्य तृतीया सोमस्य चतुर्थ्यदित्यै पञ्चमीन्द्राण्यै षष्ठी मरुतां सप्तमी बृहस्पतेरष्टम्यर्यम्णो नवमी धातुर्दशमीन्द्रस्यैकादशी वरुणस्य द्वादशी यमस्य त्रयोदशी॥
verses.tr: agneḥ pakṣatirvāyornipakṣatirindrasya tṛtīyā somasya caturthyadityai pañcamīndrāṇyai ṣaṣṭhī marutāṃ saptamī bṛhaspateraṣṭamyaryamṇo navamī dhāturdaśamīndrasyaikādaśī varuṇasya dvādaśī yamasya trayodaśī
verses.en: A The first rib is Agni's; the second Vayu's; the third Indra's; the fourth Soma's; the fifth Aditi's; the sixth ladrani's; the seventh the Maruts'; the eighth Brihaspati's', the ninth Aryaman's; the tenth Dhatar's; the eleventh Indra's; the twelfth Varuna's; the thirteenth Yama's.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्न्योः पक्षतिः सरस्वत्यै निपक्षतिर्मित्रस्य तृतीयापां चतुर्थी निरृत्यै पञ्चम्यग्नीषोमयोः षष्ठी सर्पाणां सप्तमी विष्णोरष्टमी पूष्णो नवमी त्वष्टुर्दशमीन्द्रस्यैकादशी वरुणस्य द्वादशी यम्यै त्रयोदशी द्यावापृथिव्योर्दक्षिणं पार्श्वं विश्वेषां देवानामुत्तरम्॥
verses.tr: indrāgnyoḥ pakṣatiḥ sarasvatyai nipakṣatirmitrasya tṛtīyāpāṃ caturthī nirṛtyai pañcamyagnīṣomayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī sarpāṇāṃ saptamī viṣṇoraṣṭamī pūṣṇo navamī tvaṣṭurdaśamīndrasyaikādaśī varuṇasya dvādaśī yamyai trayodaśī dyāvāpṛthivyordakṣiṇaṃ pārśvaṃ viśveṣāṃ devānāmuttaram
verses.en: (On the left side) the first rib belongs to Indra-Agni; the second to Sarasvati; the third to Mitra; the fourth to the Waters; the fifth to Nirriti; the sixth to Agnishtoma; the seventh to the Serpents; the eighth to Vishnu; the ninth to Pushan; the tenth to Tvashtar; the eleventh to Indra; the twelfth to Varuna; the thirteenth to Yama. The right flank belongs to Heaven and Earth, the left to the All-Gods.

verses.sa: मरुतां स्कन्धा विश्वेषां देवानां प्रथमा कीकसा रुद्राणां द्वितीयाऽऽदित्यानां तृतीया वायोः पुच्छमग्नीषोमयोर्भासदौ क्रुञ्चौ श्रोणिभ्यामिन्द्राबृहस्पती ऊरुभ्यां मित्रावरुणावल्गाभ्यामाक्रमणं स्थूराभ्यां बलं कुष्ठाभ्याम्॥
verses.tr: marutāṃ skandhā viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ prathamā kīkasā rudrāṇāṃ dvitīyā''dityānāṃ tṛtīyā vāyoḥ pucchamagnīṣomayorbhāsadau kruñcau śroṇibhyāmindrābṛhaspatī ūrubhyāṃ mitrāvaruṇāvalgābhyāmākramaṇaṃ sthūrābhyāṃ balaṃ kuṣṭhābhyām
verses.en: The shoulders belong to the Maruts; the first rib-cartilages to the All-Gods; the second to the Rudras; the third to the A-dityas; the tail belongs to Vayu; the hind-quarters to Agnishtoma. I gratify the two Curlews with the hips; Indra-Brihaspati with the thighs; Maitravaruna with the groins; Approach with the buttocks; Strength with the two cavities of the loins.

verses.sa: पूषणं वनिष्ठुनाऽन्धाहीन्त्स्थूलगुदया सर्पान्गुदाभिर्विह्रुत आन्त्रैरपो वस्तिना वृषणमाण्डाभ्यां वाजिनं शेपेन प्रजां रेतसा चाषान् पित्तेन प्रदरान् पायुना कूश्माञ्छकपिण्डैः॥
verses.tr: pūṣaṇaṃ vaniṣṭhunā'ndhāhīntsthūlagudayā sarpāngudābhirvihruta āntrairapo vastinā vṛṣaṇamāṇḍābhyāṃ vājinaṃ śepena prajāṃ retasā cāṣān pittena pradarān pāyunā kūśmāñchakapiṇḍaiḥ
verses.en: I gratify Pushan with the rectum; Blind-worms with the large intestines; Serpents with the entrails; Worms with the guts; the Waters with the bladder; Scrotum with the testicles; the Vajins with his penis; Offspring with his seed; Blue jays with his bile; Fissures with his arms; Kushuia with his lumps of dung.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्य क्रीडोऽदित्यै पाजस्यं दिशां जत्रवोऽदित्यै भसज्जीमूतान् हृदयौपशेनान्तरिक्षं पुरीतता नभ उदर्येण चक्रवाकौ मतस्नाभ्यां दिवं वृक्काभ्यां गिरीन् प्लाशिभिरुपलान् प्लीह्ना वल्मीकान् क्लोमभिर्ग्लौभिर्गुल्मान् हिराभिः स्रवन्तीर्ह्रदान् कुक्षिभ्यां समुद्रमुदरेण वैश्वानरं भस्मना॥
verses.tr: indrasya krīḍo'dityai pājasyaṃ diśāṃ jatravo'dityai bhasajjīmūtān hṛdayaupaśenāntarikṣaṃ purītatā nabha udaryeṇa cakravākau matasnābhyāṃ divaṃ vṛkkābhyāṃ girīn plāśibhirupalān plīhnā valmīkān klomabhirglaubhirgulmān hirābhiḥ sravantīrhradān kukṣibhyāṃ samudramudareṇa vaiśvānaraṃ bhasmanā
verses.en: His chest belongs to Indra; his belly to Aditi; his clavicles to the Quarters; his nether hind-part to Aditi. I gratify Clouds with his aorta', Firmament with his pericardium; Mist with his belly; the two Chakravakas with his cardiac bones; Sky with his kidneys; Mountains with his ducts; Rocks with his spleen; Ant-hills with his lungs; Shrubs with his heart-vessels; Streams with his veins; Lakes with his flanks; Sea with his belly; Vaisvanara with his ashes.

verses.sa: विधृतिं नाभ्या धृतं रसेनापो यूष्णा मरीचीर्विप्रुड्भिर्नीहारमूष्मणा शीनं वसया प्रुष्वा अश्रुभिर्ह्रादुनीर्दूषीकाभिरस्ना रक्षांसि चित्राण्यङ्गैर्नक्षत्राणि रूपेण पृथिवीं त्वचा जुम्बकाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vidhṛtiṃ nābhyā dhṛtaṃ rasenāpo yūṣṇā marīcīrvipruḍbhirnīhāramūṣmaṇā śīnaṃ vasayā pruṣvā aśrubhirhrādunīrdūṣīkābhirasnā rakṣāṃsi citrāṇyaṅgairnakṣatrāṇi rūpeṇa pṛthivīṃ tvacā jumbakāya svāhā
verses.en: I gratify Separation with his navel; Butter with his flavour; the Waters with his broth; Sunbeams with his drops of fat; Hoar-frost with his heat; Ice with his marrow; Hail'Stones with his tears; Thunderbolts with the rheum of his eyes; Rakshasas with his blood; Bright things with his limbs; Stars with his beauty; Earth with his skin. All-hail to Jumbaka!

verses.sa: हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेक आसीत्। स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, etc., as in XIII. 4; XXIII. 1.

verses.sa: यः प्राणतो निमिषतो महित्वैक इद्राजा जगतो बभूव। य ईशे अस्य द्विपदश्चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika idrājā jagato babhūva ya īśe asya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Who by his grandeur, etc., as in XXIII. 3.

verses.sa: यस्येमे हिमवन्तो महित्वा यस्य समुद्रं रसया सहाहुः। यस्येमाः प्रदिशो यस्य बाहू कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yasyeme himavanto mahitvā yasya samudraṃ rasayā sahāhuḥ yasyemāḥ pradiśo yasya bāhū kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Whose, by his might, are these snow-covered mountains, and men call sea and Rasa his possession: Whose are these arms, whose are these, heavenly regions. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa: य आत्मदा बलदा यस्य विश्व उपासते प्रशिषं यस्य देवाः। यस्य छायामृतं यस्य मृत्युः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Giver of vital breath, of power and vigour, he whose commandment all the Gods acknowledge: The Lord of death, whose shade is life immortal. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa: आ नो भद्राः क्रतवो यन्तु विश्वतोऽदब्धासो अपरीतास उद्भिदः। देवा नो यथा सदमिद् वृधे असन्नप्रायुवो रक्षितारो दिवे-दिवे॥
verses.tr: ā no bhadrāḥ kratavo yantu viśvato'dabdhāso aparītāsa udbhidaḥ devā no yathā sadamid vṛdhe asannaprāyuvo rakṣitāro dive-dive
verses.en: May powers auspicious come to us from every side, never deceived, unhindered and victorious, That the Gods ever may be with us for our gain, our guardians day by day, unceasing in their care.

verses.sa: देवानां भद्रा सुमतिरृजूयतां देवानां रातिरभि नो निवर्तताम्। देवानां सख्यमुपसेदिमा वयं देवा न आयुः प्रतिरन्तु जीवसे॥
verses.tr: devānāṃ bhadrā sumatirṛjūyatāṃ devānāṃ rātirabhi no nivartatām devānāṃ sakhyamupasedimā vayaṃ devā na āyuḥ pratirantu jīvase
verses.en: May the auspicious favour of the Gods be ours, on us descend the bounty of the righteous Gods. The friendship of the Gods have we devoutly, sought: so may the Gods extend our life that we may live.

verses.sa: तान्पूर्वया निविदा हूमहे वयं भगं मित्रमदितिं दक्षमस्रिधम्। अर्यमणं वरुणं सोममश्विना सरस्वती नः सुभगा मयस्करत्॥
verses.tr: tānpūrvayā nividā hūmahe vayaṃ bhagaṃ mitramaditiṃ dakṣamasridham aryamaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ somamaśvinā sarasvatī naḥ subhagā mayaskarat
verses.en: We call them hither with a hymn of olden time, Bhaga, the friendly Daksha, Mitra, Aditi, Aryaman, Varuna, Soma, the Asvins. May Sarasvati, auspicious, grant felicity.

verses.sa: तन्नो वातो मयोभु वातु भेषजं तन्माता पृथिवी तत्पिता द्यौः। तद् ग्रावाणः सोमसुतो मयोभुवस्तदश्विना शृणुतं धिष्ण्या युवम्॥
verses.tr: tanno vāto mayobhu vātu bheṣajaṃ tanmātā pṛthivī tatpitā dyauḥ tad grāvāṇaḥ somasuto mayobhuvastadaśvinā śṛṇutaṃ dhiṣṇyā yuvam
verses.en: May the Wind waft to us that pleasant medicine, may Earth our Mother give it, and our Father Heaven, And the joy-giving stones that press the Soma's juice. Asvins, may ye, for whom our spirits long, hear this.

verses.sa: तमीशानं जगतस्तस्थुषस्पतिं धियञ्जिन्वमवसे हूमहे वयम्। पूषा नो यथा वेदसामसद् वृधे रक्षिता पायुरदब्धः स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: tamīśānaṃ jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ dhiyañjinvamavase hūmahe vayam pūṣā no yathā vedasāmasad vṛdhe rakṣitā pāyuradabdhaḥ svastaye
verses.en: Him we invoke for aid who reigns supreme, the Lord of all that stands or moves, inspirer of the soul. That Pushan may promote the increase of our wealth, our keeper and our guard infallible for our good.

verses.sa: स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाः स्वस्ति नः पूषा विश्ववेदाः। स्वस्ति नस्तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टनेमिः स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु॥
verses.tr: svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu
verses.en: Illustrious far and wide, may Indra prosper us: may Pushan prosper us, the Master of all wealth. May Tarkshya, with uninjured fellies prosper us: Brihaspati vouchsafe to us prosperity.

verses.sa: पृषदश्वा मरुतः पृश्निमातरः शुभंयावानो विदथेषु जग्मयः। अग्निजिह्वा मनवः सूरचक्षसो विश्वे नो देवा अवसागमन्निह॥
verses.tr: pṛṣadaśvā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhaṃyāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ agnijihvā manavaḥ sūracakṣaso viśve no devā avasāgamanniha
verses.en: The Maruts, Sons of Prisni, borne by spotted steeds, moving in glory, oft visiting holy rites, Sages whose tongue is Agni and their eyes the Sun,—hither let all the Gods for our protection come.

verses.sa: भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः। स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिर्व्यशेमहि देवहितं यदायुः॥
verses.tr: bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhirvyaśemahi devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ
verses.en: Gods, may we with our ears listen to what is good, and with our eyes see what is good, ye Holy Ones. With limbs and bodies firm may we extolling you attain the term of life appointed by the Gods.

verses.sa: शतमिन्नु शरदो अन्ति देवा यत्रा नश्चक्रा जरसं तनूनाम्। पुत्रासो यत्र पितरो भवन्ति मा नो मध्या रीरिषतायुर्गन्तोः॥
verses.tr: śataminnu śarado anti devā yatrā naścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyurgantoḥ
verses.en: A hundred autumns stand before us, O ye Gods, within whose space ye bring our bodies to decay; Within whose space our sons become fathers in turn. Break ye not in the midst our course of fleeting life.

verses.sa: अदितिर्द्यौरदितिरन्तरिक्षमदितिर्माता स पिता स पुत्रः। विश्वे देवा अदितिः पञ्च जना अदितिर्जातमदितिर्जनित्वम्॥
verses.tr: aditirdyauraditirantarikṣamaditirmātā sa pitā sa putraḥ viśve devā aditiḥ pañca janā aditirjātamaditirjanitvam
verses.en: Aditi is the heaven, Aditi is mid-air, Aditi is the Mother and the Sire and Son. Aditi is All Gods, Aditi five-classed men, Aditi all that hath been born and shall be born.

verses.sa: मा नो मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमायुरिन्द्र ऋभुक्षा मरुतः परि ख्यन्। यद्वाजिनो देवजातस्य सप्तेः प्रवक्ष्यामो विदथे वीर्याणि॥
verses.tr: mā no mitro varuṇo aryamāyurindra ṛbhukṣā marutaḥ pari khyan yadvājino devajātasya sapteḥ pravakṣyāmo vidathe vīryāṇi
verses.en: Slight us not Varuna, Aryaman, or Mitra, Ribhukshan, Indra, Vayu, or the Maruts, When we declare amid the congregation the virtues of the Strong Steed, God-descended.

verses.sa: यन्निर्णिजा रेक्णसा प्रावृतस्य रातिं गृभीतां मुखतो नयन्ति। सुप्राङजो मेम्यद्विश्वरूप इन्द्रापूष्णोः प्रियमप्येति पाथः॥
verses.tr: yannirṇijā rekṇasā prāvṛtasya rātiṃ gṛbhītāṃ mukhato nayanti suprāṅajo memyadviśvarūpa indrāpūṣṇoḥ priyamapyeti pāthaḥ
verses.en: What time they bear before the Courser, covered with trappings and with wealth, the grasped oblation. The dappled goat goeth straightforward, bleating, to the place dear to Indra and to Pushan.

verses.sa: एष छागः पुरो अश्वेन वाजिना पूष्णो भागो नीयते विश्वदेव्यः। अभिप्रियं यत्पुरोडाशमर्वता त्वष्टेदेनं सौश्रवसाय जिन्वति॥
verses.tr: eṣa chāgaḥ puro aśvena vājinā pūṣṇo bhāgo nīyate viśvadevyaḥ abhipriyaṃ yatpuroḍāśamarvatā tvaṣṭedenaṃ sauśravasāya jinvati
verses.en: Dear to all Gods, this goat, the share of Pushan, is first led forward with the vigorous Courser, While Tvashtar sends him forward with the Charger, acceptable for sacrifice, to glory.

verses.sa: यद्धविष्यमृतुशो देवयानं त्रिर्मानुषाः पर्यश्वं नयन्ति। अत्रा पूष्णः प्रथमो भाग एति यज्ञं देवेभ्यः प्रतिवेदयन्नजः॥
verses.tr: yaddhaviṣyamṛtuśo devayānaṃ trirmānuṣāḥ paryaśvaṃ nayanti atrā pūṣṇaḥ prathamo bhāga eti yajñaṃ devebhyaḥ prativedayannajaḥ
verses.en: When thrice the men lead round the Steed, in order, who goeth to the Gods as meet oblation. The goat precedeth him, the share of Pushan, and to the Gods the sacrifice announceth.

verses.sa: होताध्वर्युरावया अग्निमिन्धो ग्रावग्राभ उत शंस्ता सुविप्रः। तेन यज्ञेन स्वरंकृतेन स्विष्टेन वक्षणा आ पृणध्वम्॥
verses.tr: hotādhvaryurāvayā agnimindho grāvagrābha uta śaṃstā suvipraḥ tena yajñena svaraṃkṛtena sviṣṭena vakṣaṇā ā pṛṇadhvam
verses.en: Invoker, ministering priest, atoner, fire-kindler. Soma-presser, sage, reciter. With this well ordered sacrifice, well finished, do ye fill full the channels of the rivers.

verses.sa: यूपव्रस्का उत ये यूपवाहाश्चषालं ये अश्वयूपाय तक्षति। ये चार्वते पचनं सम्भरन्त्युतो तेषामभिगूर्तिर्न इन्वतु॥
verses.tr: yūpavraskā uta ye yūpavāhāścaṣālaṃ ye aśvayūpāya takṣati ye cārvate pacanaṃ sambharantyuto teṣāmabhigūrtirna invatu
verses.en: The hewers of the post and those who carry it, and those who carve the knob to deck the Horse's stake; Those who prepare the cooking-vessels for the Steed,—may the approving help of these promote our work.

verses.sa: उप प्रागात्सुमन्मेऽधायि मन्म देवानामाशा उप वीतपृष्ठः। अन्वेनं विप्रा ऋषयो मदन्ति देवानां पुष्टे चकृमा सुबन्धुम्॥
verses.tr: upa prāgātsumanme'dhāyi manma devānāmāśā upa vītapṛṣṭhaḥ anvenaṃ viprā ṛṣayo madanti devānāṃ puṣṭe cakṛmā subandhum
verses.en: Forth, for the regions of the Gods, the Charger with his smooth back is come; my prayer attends him. In him rejoice the singer and the sages. A good friend have we won for the Gods banquet.

verses.sa: यद्वाजिनो दाम सन्दानमर्वतो या शीर्षण्या रशना रज्जुरस्य। यद्वा घास्य प्रभृतमास्ये तृणं सर्वा ता ते अपि देवेष्वस्तु॥
verses.tr: yadvājino dāma sandānamarvato yā śīrṣaṇyā raśanā rajjurasya yadvā ghāsya prabhṛtamāsye tṛṇaṃ sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu
verses.en: May the fleet Courser's halter and his heel-ropes, the headstall and the girths and cords about him, And the grass put within his mouth to bait him,—among the Gods, too, let all these be with thee.

verses.sa: यदश्वस्य क्रविषो मक्षिकाश यद्वा स्वरौ स्वधितौ रिप्तमस्ति। यद्धस्तयोः शमितुर्यन्नखेषु सर्वा ता ते अपि देवेष्वस्तु॥
verses.tr: yadaśvasya kraviṣo makṣikāśa yadvā svarau svadhitau riptamasti yaddhastayoḥ śamituryannakheṣu sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu
verses.en: What part of the Steed's flesh the fly hath eaten, or is left sticking to the post or hatchet, Or to the slayer's hands and nails adhereth,—among the Gods, too, may all this be with thee.

verses.sa: यदूवध्यमुदरस्यापवाति य आमस्य क्रविषो गन्धो अस्ति। सुकृता तच्छमितारः कृण्वन्तूत मेधं शृतपाकं पचन्तु॥
verses.tr: yadūvadhyamudarasyāpavāti ya āmasya kraviṣo gandho asti sukṛtā tacchamitāraḥ kṛṇvantūta medhaṃ śṛtapākaṃ pacantu
verses.en: Food undigested steaming from his belly, and any odour of raw flesh remaining. This let the immolators set in order and dress the sacrifice with perfect cooking.

verses.sa: यत्ते गात्रादग्निना पच्यमानादभि शूलं निहतस्यावधावति। मा तद्भूम्यामाश्रिषन्मा तृणेषु देवेभ्यस्तदुशद्भ्यो रातमस्तु॥
verses.tr: yatte gātrādagninā pacyamānādabhi śūlaṃ nihatasyāvadhāvati mā tadbhūmyāmāśriṣanmā tṛṇeṣu devebhyastaduśadbhyo rātamastu
verses.en: What from thy body which with fire is roasted, when thou art set upon the spit, distilleth,—Let not that lie on earth or grass neglected, but to the longing Gods let all be offered.

verses.sa: ये वाजिनं परिपश्यन्ति पक्वं य ईमाहुः सुरभिर्निर्हरेति। ये चार्वतो मांसभिक्षामुपासत उतो तेषामभिगूर्तिर्न इन्वतु॥
verses.tr: ye vājinaṃ paripaśyanti pakvaṃ ya īmāhuḥ surabhirnirhareti ye cārvato māṃsabhikṣāmupāsata uto teṣāmabhigūrtirna invatu
verses.en: They who, observing that the Horse is ready, call out and say. The smell is good; remove it; And, craving meat, await the distribution,—may their approving help promote our labour.

verses.sa: यन्नीक्षणं माँस्पचन्या उखाया या पात्राणि यूष्ण आसेचनानि। ऊष्मण्यापिधाना चरूणामङ्काः सूनाः परि भूषन्त्यश्वम्॥
verses.tr: yannīkṣaṇaṃ māṃspacanyā ukhāyā yā pātrāṇi yūṣṇa āsecanāni ūṣmaṇyāpidhānā carūṇāmaṅkāḥ sūnāḥ pari bhūṣantyaśvam
verses.en: The trial-fork of the flesh-cooking caldron, the vessels out of which the broth is sprinkled. The warming-pots, the covers of the dishes, hooks, carving-boards,—all these attend the Charger.

verses.sa: मा त्वाऽग्निर्ध्वनयीद्धूमगन्धिर्मोखा भ्राजन्त्यभि विक्त जघ्रिः। इष्टं वीतमभिगूर्तं वषट्कृतं तं देवासः प्रति गृभ्णन्त्यश्वम्॥
verses.tr: mā tvā'gnirdhvanayīddhūmagandhirmokhā bhrājantyabhi vikta jaghriḥ iṣṭaṃ vītamabhigūrtaṃ vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ taṃ devāsaḥ prati gṛbhṇantyaśvam
verses.en: Let not the fire, smoke-scented, make thee crackle, nor glowing caldron smell and break to pieces. Offered, beloved, approved, and consecrated,—such Charger do the Gods accept with favour.

verses.sa: निक्रमणं निषदनं विवर्तनं यच्च पड्वीशमर्वतः। यच्च पपौ यच्च घासिं जघास सर्वा ता ते अपि देवेष्वस्तु॥
verses.tr: nikramaṇaṃ niṣadanaṃ vivartanaṃ yacca paḍvīśamarvataḥ yacca papau yacca ghāsiṃ jaghāsa sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu
verses.en: The starting-place, his place of rest and rolling, the ropes wherewith the Charger's feet were fastened. The water that he drank, the food he tasted,—among the Gods, too, may all these attend thee.

verses.sa: यदश्वाय वास उपस्तृणन्त्यधीवासं या हिरण्यान्यस्मै। सन्दानमर्वन्तं पड्वीशं प्रिया देवेष्वा यामयन्ति॥
verses.tr: yadaśvāya vāsa upastṛṇantyadhīvāsaṃ yā hiraṇyānyasmai sandānamarvantaṃ paḍvīśaṃ priyā deveṣvā yāmayanti
verses.en: The robe they spread upon the Horse to clothe him, the upper covering and the golden trappings, The halters which restrain the Steed, the heel-ropes,—all these, as grateful to the Gods, they offer.

verses.sa: यत्ते सादे महसा शूकृतस्य पार्ष्ण्या वा कशया वा तुतोद। स्रुचेव ता हविषो अध्वरेषु सर्वा ता ते ब्रह्मणा सूदयामि॥
verses.tr: yatte sāde mahasā śūkṛtasya pārṣṇyā vā kaśayā vā tutoda sruceva tā haviṣo adhvareṣu sarvā tā te brahmaṇā sūdayāmi
verses.en: If one, when seated, with excessive urging hath with his heel or with his whip distressed thee. All these thy woes, as with oblation's ladle at sacrifices, with my prayer I banish.

verses.sa: चतुस्त्रिंशद्वाजिनो देवबन्धोर्वङ्क्रीरश्वस्य स्वधितिः समेति। अच्छिद्रा गात्रा वयुना कृणोत परुष्परुरनुघुष्या विशस्त॥
verses.tr: catustriṃśadvājino devabandhorvaṅkrīraśvasya svadhitiḥ sameti acchidrā gātrā vayunā kṛṇota paruṣparuranughuṣyā viśasta
verses.en: The four-and-thirty ribs of the swift Courser, kin to the Gods, the slayer's hatchet pierces. Cut ye with skill so that the parts be flawless, and piece by piece declaring them dissect them.

verses.sa: एकस्त्वष्टुरश्वस्या विशस्ता द्वा यन्तारा भवतस्तथ ऋतुः। या ते गात्राणामृतुथा कृणोमि ता-ता पिण्डानां प्र जुहोम्यग्नौ॥
verses.tr: ekastvaṣṭuraśvasyā viśastā dvā yantārā bhavatastatha ṛtuḥ yā te gātrāṇāmṛtuthā kṛṇomi tā-tā piṇḍānāṃ pra juhomyagnau
verses.en: Of Tvashtar's Courser there is one dissector: this is the custom: two there are who guide him. Such of his limbs as I divide in order, all these, amid the lumps, in fire I offer.

verses.sa: मा त्वा तपत्प्रिय आत्माऽपियन्तं मा स्वधितिस्तन्व आ तिष्ठिपत्ते। मा ते गृध्नुरविशस्ताऽतिहाय छिद्रा गात्राण्यसिना मिथू कः॥
verses.tr: mā tvā tapatpriya ātmā'piyantaṃ mā svadhitistanva ā tiṣṭhipatte mā te gṛdhnuraviśastā'tihāya chidrā gātrāṇyasinā mithū kaḥ
verses.en: Let not thy dear soul burn thee as thou comest, let not the hatchet linger in thy body. Let not a greedy clumsy immolator, missing the joints, mangle thy limbs unduly.

verses.sa: न वा उ एतन्म्रियसे न रिष्यसि देवाँ२ इदेषि पथिभिः सुगेभिः। हरी ते युञ्जा पृषती अभूतामुपास्थाद्वाजी धुरि रासभस्य॥
verses.tr: na vā u etanmriyase na riṣyasi devāṃ2 ideṣi pathibhiḥ sugebhiḥ harī te yuñjā pṛṣatī abhūtāmupāsthādvājī dhuri rāsabhasya
verses.en: No, here thou diest not, thou art not injured: only by easy paths to Gods thou goest. Both Bays, both Spotted Mares are now thy fellows, and to the Ass's pole is yoked the Courser.

verses.sa: सुगव्यं नो वाजी स्वश्व्यं पुंसः पुत्राँ२ उत विश्वापुषं रयिम्। अनागास्त्वं नो अदितिः कृणोतु क्षत्रं नो अश्वो वनतां हविष्मान्॥
verses.tr: sugavyaṃ no vājī svaśvyaṃ puṃsaḥ putrāṃ2 uta viśvāpuṣaṃ rayim anāgāstvaṃ no aditiḥ kṛṇotu kṣatraṃ no aśvo vanatāṃ haviṣmān
verses.en: May this Steed bring us all-sustaining riches, wealth in good kine, good horses, manly offspring. Freedom from sin may Aditi vouchsafe us; the Steed with our oblations gain us lordship!

verses.sa: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधामेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः। आदित्यैरिन्द्रः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्मभ्यं भेषजा करत्। यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चादित्यैरिन्द्रः सह सीषधाति॥
verses.tr: imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāmendraśca viśve ca devāḥ ādityairindraḥ sagaṇo marudbhirasmabhyaṃ bheṣajā karat yajñaṃ ca nastanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cādityairindraḥ saha sīṣadhāti
verses.en: We will, with Indra and all Gods to help us, bring these existing worlds into subjection. With the Adityas, with the band of Maruts, may Indra give us medicine to heal us. Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspring may Indra regulate with the Adityas.

verses.sa: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भव वरूथ्यः। वसुरग्निर्वसुश्रवा अच्छा नक्षि द्युमत्तमं रयिं दाः। तं त्वा शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सुम्नाय नूनमीमहे सखिभ्यः॥
verses.tr: agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhava varūthyaḥ vasuragnirvasuśravā acchā nakṣi dyumattamaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnamīmahe sakhibhyaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, be our nearest Friend, etc., as in III. 25. To thee then, O Most Bright, etc., as in III. 26.
